prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: independent background illustration for a fishing game's event route map, near-square slightly portrait 4:5 aspect, opaque painted scene without any UI.
Input image 1 approved mail UI and image 2 approved team UI: PRIMARY Daoist Q hand-painted style, rounded jade/ivory/gold materials, clean soft scenic detail. Input image 3 is the existing event-detail UI: use ONLY the left seaside-island illustration as art and terrain reference, not its icons, route lines, text, panels or controls.
Create one bright turquoise miniature sea archipelago illustration seen from a gentle elevated isometric camera. Include EXACTLY FIVE clearly separated small rounded rocky islets with mostly flat quiet warm-ivory stone top surfaces left EMPTY for future independent game nodes: approximate normalized centers (0.25,0.16), (0.70,0.31), (0.70,0.55), (0.28,0.70), (0.70,0.87). These are terrain islands, NOT circles or icons. Keep each plateau about 12 to 15 percent of canvas width and visually clear, with coral, grass, small pebble, jade shrub only around island rims. The rest of the sea has gentle fine hand-painted ripples and sparse pale jade submerged rocks. Top distance may show subtle Daoist mountain/pavilion hints; outer lower-left may contain a small timber pier and tiny warm lantern, without obstructing any empty island top.
Important: all five island top areas remain clear and unoccupied. Draw NO route line, dotted path, shell, pearl, treasure chest, compass/map pin, marker, checkmark, lock, number, badge, circle, banner, text, UI panel or character. No fish, turtles or companions in the map; all interactive nodes and states will be added by separate game assets. Do not reproduce the old UI. One continuous standalone terrain illustration, fully painted to canvas edges, no border, no frame or transparent corner.
Style: same Daoist Q high-definition hand-painted game art as reference, rounded substantial forms, jade-green/cyan-blue dominant, warm ivory flat stone, fine restrained gold only on remote architectural details, soft clean lighting, readable spacious layout and no dense noise.
